summary: Python publisher for fixed plan ID vdd-conformance-exact-cover; requires repository root, plan directory, in-plan skill-input receipt, and explicit maintainer authorization flag; validates contract ID, implementation-authorized plan state, ready receipt, and source-selection/content-root identities; hashes JSON canonically and other files as raw bytes; creates authority, predecessor, repair-state, validation, candidate, delta, and successor authorization receipt artifacts; generation records receipt/source/context/semantic/child hashes plus canonical generation root; successor receipt binds required artifacts and declares maintainer transition; authorizes implementation-authorized only; explicitly excludes implementation-complete, acceptance, knowledge publication, bootstrap review, and release; failures raise on missing authorization, invalid plan, out-of-plan receipt, or unready identity data
